title.en: Experimental study of the photoelectric effect

heading.en: Turning the knobs of a photocell

hook.en: In a photocell we can change three things: the brightness of the light, its colour, and the voltage. Each tells us something surprising about light.
hook.kn: ದ್ಯುತಿಕೋಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂರು ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಬಹುದು: ಬೆಳಕಿನ ತೀವ್ರತೆ, ಅದರ ಬಣ್ಣ (ಆವೃತ್ತಿ) ಮತ್ತು ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದೂ ಬೆಳಕಿನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅಚ್ಚರಿಯ ಸಂಗತಿ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Describe the effect of intensity, potential and frequency
Define stopping potential and threshold frequency

narration.en: In a photocell we can change three things: the brightness of the light, its colour, and the voltage. Each tells us something surprising about light.
narration.kn: ದ್ಯುತಿಕೋಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂರು ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಬಹುದು: ಬೆಳಕಿನ ತೀವ್ರತೆ, ಅದರ ಬಣ್ಣ (ಆವೃತ್ತಿ) ಮತ್ತು ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದೂ ಬೆಳಕಿನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅಚ್ಚರಿಯ ಸಂಗತಿ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: The photocurrent is proportional to the intensity of light. As the collector is made more positive the current rises to a saturation value. Making the collector negative reduces the current; at the stopping potential $V_0$ even the fastest electrons are stopped, so $K_{max} = eV_0$. For a given frequency, $V_0$ is the same for all intensities.
body.kn: ದ್ಯುತಿಪ್ರವಾಹವು ಬೆಳಕಿನ ತೀವ್ರತೆಗೆ ಅನುಪಾತೀಯ. ನಿಲುಗಡೆ ವಿಭವ V₀ ನಲ್ಲಿ ವೇಗದ ಎಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಾನ್‌ಗಳೂ ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತವೆ: K_max = eV₀. V₀ ತೀವ್ರತೆಯನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

narration.en: The photocurrent is proportional to the intensity of light. As the collector is made more positive the current rises to a saturation value. Making the collector negative reduces the current; at the stopping potential V_0 even the fastest electrons are stopped, so K_{max} = eV_0. For a given frequency, V_0 is the same for all intensities.
narration.kn: ದ್ಯುತಿಪ್ರವಾಹವು ಬೆಳಕಿನ ತೀವ್ರತೆಗೆ ಅನುಪಾತೀಯ. ನಿಲುಗಡೆ ವಿಭವ V₀ ನಲ್ಲಿ ವೇಗದ ಎಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಾನ್‌ಗಳೂ ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತವೆ: K_max = eV₀. V₀ ತೀವ್ರತೆಯನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

narration.en: Let us draw Lenard's apparatus and the graphs it gives.

say.en: In an evacuated tube, light falls on the emitter plate C. Electrons fly to the collector A, and the ammeter shows a photocurrent. The battery can be reversed.
Current against potential: brighter light gives a bigger saturation current, but the current stops at the same stopping potential.
Higher frequency gives a larger stopping potential. Below a threshold frequency there is no emission at all.
The stopping potential measures the fastest electrons: K_max = eV₀. A stopping potential of 1.5 V means K_max = 1.5 eV. And emission starts with no time lag.

body.en: The stopping potential increases linearly with frequency. Below a threshold frequency $\nu_0$, characteristic of the metal, no electrons come out however intense the light. Above it, emission begins instantly, within about $10^{-9}$ s, even in dim light.
body.kn: ನಿಲುಗಡೆ ವಿಭವ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ರೇಖೀಯವಾಗಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ. ಆರಂಭಿಕ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ν₀ ಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಉತ್ಸರ್ಜನೆ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಉತ್ಸರ್ಜನೆ ತಕ್ಷಣ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: The stopping potential increases linearly with frequency. Below a threshold frequency \nu_0, characteristic of the metal, no electrons come out however intense the light. Above it, emission begins instantly, within about 10^{-9} s, even in dim light.
narration.kn: ನಿಲುಗಡೆ ವಿಭವ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ರೇಖೀಯವಾಗಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ. ಆರಂಭಿಕ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ν₀ ಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಉತ್ಸರ್ಜನೆ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಉತ್ಸರ್ಜನೆ ತಕ್ಷಣ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.

aim.en: To study the photoelectric effect and find Planck's constant and the work function of the cathode.

narration.en: In this virtual photocell, change the colour and brightness of the light and the collector voltage, and plot stopping potential against frequency.
Change the intensity and the frequency separately and see which part of the graph each one moves.

caption.en: Photocurrent against collector potential for a metal of φ₀ = 2.3 eV. Intensity sets the saturation current; frequency sets the stopping potential.

problem.en: In a photocell the photocurrent just stops when the collector is at −1.5 V. Find the maximum kinetic energy of the photoelectrons.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. In a photocell the photocurrent just stops when the collector is at −1.5 V. Find the maximum kinetic energy of the photoelectrons.
Roll-call quiz. When your roll number is called, give your answer.
narration.kn: ಹಾಜರಾತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕ್ರಮಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಕರೆದಾಗ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಉತ್ತರ ಹೇಳಿ.

narration.en: Now two competitive-exam pattern questions. Try them before we discuss.

points.en: Stopping potential depends on frequency, not intensity.
No emission below the threshold frequency; emission is instantaneous.
points.kn: ಆರಂಭಿಕ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಉತ್ಸರ್ಜನೆ ಇಲ್ಲ; ಉತ್ಸರ್ಜನೆ ತಕ್ಷಣ.

homework.en: Sketch photocurrent vs collector potential for two intensities and for two frequencies.

narration.en: Recap. Photocurrent is proportional to intensity. Stopping potential depends on frequency, not intensity. No emission below the threshold frequency; emission is instantaneous.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ದ್ಯುತಿಪ್ರವಾಹ ತೀವ್ರತೆಗೆ ಅನುಪಾತೀಯ. ನಿಲುಗಡೆ ವಿಭವ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ತೀವ್ರತೆಯನ್ನಲ್ಲ. ಆರಂಭಿಕ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಉತ್ಸರ್ಜನೆ ಇಲ್ಲ; ಉತ್ಸರ್ಜನೆ ತಕ್ಷಣ.
